category.reason: The described pregnancy matches “First pregnancy” and “Multiples.” The first card is already selected, so “Multiples” is the next applicable option.

instruction.en: I conceived naturally and am pregnant with multiples. This pregnancy was planned, it is my first pregnancy, and I do not plan to become pregnant again. Check that all applicable options are selected. If they are, proceed to the next step; otherwise, select the next applicable option, scanning each row from left to right and moving from the top row to the bottom.
instruction.zh: 我通过自然怀孕怀上了多胞胎，这次怀孕在计划之内，这是我的首次怀孕并且我之后不再打算继续怀孕。请检查并确保已勾选所有符合的选项，如果已满足要求则进入下一步，否则帮我按照从左至右、从上至下的顺序继续选中我需要选中的下一个选项。
